Method of Attack: Distributed through spam emails targeting victims in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, and Croatia
Spam emails contain malicious Word documents with macros that download and install File Spider ransomware
Macro contains Base64 encoded PowerShell script that downloads XOR encrypted executables (enc.exe and dec.exe)
Executables decrypt and run ransomware encryptor and decryptor
Encryptor scans local drives and encrypts files with AES-128 encryption, appending .spider extension
Creates ransom notes and GUI for ransom payment via TOR site
Impacted Systems: Windows computers in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Croatia
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious Word document attachment containing macros
User enabling editing and content in Word document triggers download and execution
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text and ransom payment site on TOR: http://spiderwjzbmsmu7y.onion
